    GuidedTutorial.rotate(int axis, double degrees, long durationMs)
    Returns a GuidedTutorial.Step camera action that orbits the view by degrees around axis (0 = X, i.e. tumbling around the horizontal screen axis; 1 = Y, tumbling around the vertical screen axis; 2 = Z, spinning in-plane around the line of sight), pivoting on the current screen center - i.e. on whatever the step's own roi just centered via flyTo(BoundingBox) - so the framed region stays put and only orbits, rather than swinging off-screen.
